QF.id: I Clearing Settlement and Risk Management_8

question.text: Extreme Loss Margin (ELM) for USDINR futures is:

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the workbook (pp.175-176), USDINR futures attract an Extreme Loss Margin (ELM) of 0.50%, while USDINR options attract an ELM of 0.75%. Cross-currency futures (EURUSD, GBPUSD, USDJPY) also attract an ELM of 0.50%. The Trap: 1% is incorrect for USDINR futures; 0.75% applies to USDINR options, not futures. Note: For calendar-spread positions, ELM is levied on one-third of the far-month MTM value where relevant.
